source.title: JPL Horizons vector tables of Artemis 1 (spacecraft) (-1023) and Moon (301), relative to the middle of the Earth. This file holds the positions projected into the plane of the orbit of the Moon, and the numbers are rounded.
source.credit: Giorgini, JD and JPL Solar System Dynamics Group, NASA/JPL Horizons On-Line Ephemeris System, https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/horizons/, data retrieved 2026-NOV-15.
